text:
You’re launching a high-end recovery brand in the GCC and need a clear brand identity, messaging, and Shopify presence that resonates with an Arabic-origin audience.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be glad to help you shape a brand that feels premium, consistent, and easy to recognize across digital and traditional channels. While my background is in machine learning and NLP, the core of my work has always been turning research, data, and user signals into practical systems and clear decisions. That approach fits well with brand strategy work that depends on understanding the audience, market positioning, and how people respond to messaging.

For your project, I can support the brand foundation end to end:
- market research to map audience needs, trends, and competitor positioning
- brand strategy and messaging aligned with athlete recovery and premium wellness
- brand name direction, visual identity guidance, and brand guidelines
- communication planning across social, digital, and traditional channels
- Shopify store UI/UX direction to keep the brand experience polished and cohesive

I’d also focus on consistency between the product, the visual language, and the buyer journey so the brand feels credible for both personal and commercial buyers. Since you specifically mentioned the GCC market and an Arabic-origin audience, I would pay close attention to tone, naming, and cultural fit throughout the process.

A relevant example from my experience is grocery demand forecasting for Marrow & Pine Grocers. In that project, I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. The result was WAPE improving from 31% to 19%, and spoilage write-offs dropped 11% in the pilot stores. That work required careful analysis, pattern recognition, and translating complex inputs into something operationally useful — the same discipline I’d bring to brand research and decision-making.

If you’d like, I can help you define a premium brand system that is structured, audience-aware, and ready to scale with your launch.
